meanings.en: the quality of having no end or limit
meanings.exampleEn: The endlessness of the desert made them feel very small.
meanings.exampleTr: Çölün sonsuzluğu onları çok küçük hissettirdi.

meanings.en: to give a large amount of money to an institution to provide it with an income
meanings.exampleEn: A wealthy graduate endowed the university with a new library.
meanings.exampleTr: Varlıklı bir mezun üniversiteye yeni bir kütüphane bağışladı.

meanings.en: to give someone or something a quality or ability
meanings.exampleEn: She was endowed with great intelligence and charm.
meanings.exampleTr: O, büyük bir zeka ve cazibeyle donatılmıştı.

meanings.en: money given to an institution to provide it with a regular income
meanings.exampleEn: The college relies on its large endowment to fund scholarships.
meanings.exampleTr: Üniversite burslarını finanse etmek için büyük vakıf fonuna dayanıyor.

meanings.en: a natural quality or ability that a person has
meanings.exampleEn: Her musical endowment was obvious from an early age.
meanings.exampleTr: Müzikal yeteneği erken yaşta belliydi.

meanings.en: able to be tolerated or borne
meanings.exampleEn: The pain was just endurable with the help of medication.
meanings.exampleTr: İlaç yardımıyla acı ancak katlanılabilir düzeydeydi.

meanings.en: making you feel more energetic and lively
meanings.exampleEn: A cold shower can be surprisingly energising in the morning.
meanings.exampleTr: Soğuk bir duş sabahları şaşırtıcı derecede canlandırıcı olabilir.

meanings.en: so interesting that it takes all your attention
meanings.exampleEn: The novel was so engrossing that I read it in one sitting.
meanings.exampleTr: Roman o kadar sürükleyiciydi ki bir oturuşta okudum.

meanings.en: a substance or thing that improves the quality or intensity of something
meanings.exampleEn: Salt is often used as a flavour enhancer in cooking.
meanings.exampleTr: Tuz yemeklerde sıklıkla bir lezzet artırıcı olarak kullanılır.

meanings.en: to catch someone or something in a trap, or to trick them into a situation
meanings.exampleEn: The scheme was designed to ensnare unsuspecting investors.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu düzen habersiz yatırımcıları tuzağa düşürmek için tasarlanmıştı.

meanings.en: the business of providing films, music, shows and other amusements to the public
meanings.exampleEn: She has worked in the entertainment industry for over twenty years.
meanings.exampleTr: O, yirmi yılı aşkın süredir eğlence sektöründe çalışıyor.

meanings.en: to place a king, queen or bishop on a throne in a formal ceremony
meanings.exampleEn: The young queen was enthroned in a grand cathedral.
meanings.exampleTr: Genç kraliçe görkemli bir katedralde tahta çıkarıldı.

meanings.en: in a way that is attractive and makes you want something
meanings.exampleEn: The cakes were enticingly displayed in the shop window.
meanings.exampleTr: Pastalar dükkan vitrininde cazip bir şekilde sergilenmişti.

meanings.en: the whole of something
meanings.exampleEn: The speech was broadcast in its entirety.
meanings.exampleTr: Konuşma tamamı ile yayınlandı.

meanings.en: to bury a body or trap something as if in a tomb
meanings.exampleEn: The miners were entombed underground for several days.
meanings.exampleTr: Madenciler günlerce yer altında gömülü kaldı.

meanings.en: buried or trapped as if in a tomb
meanings.exampleEn: The ancient king lay entombed beneath the pyramid.
meanings.exampleTr: Kadim kral piramidin altında gömülü yatıyordu.

meanings.en: the act of burying someone in a tomb
meanings.exampleEn: The entombment of the pharaoh was an elaborate ritual.
meanings.exampleTr: Firavunun defnedilmesi ayrıntılı bir ritüeldi.

meanings.en: the area or room just inside the main door of a building
meanings.exampleEn: They hung their coats in the entrance hall.
meanings.exampleTr: Paltolarını giriş holüne astılar.

meanings.en: an earnest or urgent request
meanings.exampleEn: Despite her tearful entreaties, he refused to stay.
meanings.exampleTr: Gözyaşları içindeki yalvarışlarına rağmen kalmayı reddetti.

meanings.en: the main course of a meal, especially in North America
meanings.exampleEn: For my entrée I ordered grilled salmon.
meanings.exampleTr: Ana yemek olarak ızgara somon sipariş ettim.

meanings.en: the right or means to enter a place or group
meanings.exampleEn: Her talent gave her an entrée into the world of fashion.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeteneği ona moda dünyasına giriş hakkı sağladı.

meanings.en: to consider one thing to be the same as or equal to another
meanings.exampleEn: Many people wrongly equate wealth with happiness.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok insan yanlışlıkla zenginliği mutlulukla bir tutar.

meanings.en: relating to horse riding
meanings.exampleEn: She won a medal in an equestrian event at the Olympics.
meanings.exampleTr: Olimpiyatlarda bir binicilik yarışında madalya kazandı.

meanings.en: a person on horseback
meanings.exampleEn: The statue depicts an equestrian in full armour.
meanings.exampleTr: Heykel tam zırhlı bir atlıyı tasvir ediyor.

meanings.en: providing someone or something with the necessary items or skills
meanings.exampleEn: The school is equipping every classroom with new computers.
meanings.exampleTr: Okul her sınıfı yeni bilgisayarlarla donatıyor.

meanings.en: the state of being equal in value, amount, meaning or importance
meanings.exampleEn: There is no exact equivalence between the two currencies.
meanings.exampleTr: İki para birimi arasında tam bir eşdeğerlik yoktur.

meanings.en: the complete destruction or removal of something
meanings.exampleEn: The eradication of smallpox was a major medical achievement.
meanings.exampleTr: Çiçek hastalığının kökünün kazınması büyük bir tıbbi başarıydı.

meanings.en: gradually worn away or weakened
meanings.exampleEn: The heavily eroded cliffs are slowly falling into the sea.
meanings.exampleTr: Ağır şekilde aşınmış kayalıklar yavaş yavaş denize kayıyor.

meanings.en: gradually reduced or destroyed over time
meanings.exampleEn: Years of scandal had eroded public trust in the government.
meanings.exampleTr: Yıllarca süren skandallar halkın hükümete olan güvenini aşındırmıştı.

meanings.en: in a way that is wrong or incorrect
meanings.exampleEn: The report erroneously stated that the company was bankrupt.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor şirketin iflas ettiğini yanlış bir şekilde belirtti.

meanings.en: having or showing great knowledge gained from study
meanings.exampleEn: His erudite lecture impressed even the senior professors.
meanings.exampleTr: Bilgi dolu dersi kıdemli profesörleri bile etkiledi.

meanings.en: a person who has escaped, especially from prison
meanings.exampleEn: Police are searching for the escapee who fled last night.
meanings.exampleTr: Polis dün gece kaçan firariyi arıyor.

meanings.en: an approximate calculation or judgement of value, amount or size
meanings.exampleEn: In my estimation, the project will take about three months.
meanings.exampleTr: Benim tahminime göre proje yaklaşık üç ay sürecek.

meanings.en: the respect or regard in which someone or something is held
meanings.exampleEn: Her honesty raised her in the estimation of her colleagues.
meanings.exampleTr: Dürüstlüğü onu meslektaşlarının gözünde yükseltti.

meanings.en: the state of no longer being on friendly terms with someone close to you
meanings.exampleEn: After years of estrangement, the brothers finally reconciled.
meanings.exampleTr: Yıllarca süren küslüğün ardından kardeşler nihayet barıştı.

meanings.en: to cut a design or letters into a hard surface using acid or a sharp tool
meanings.exampleEn: The jeweller etched their initials into the ring.
meanings.exampleTr: Kuyumcu baş harflerini yüzüğe kazıdı.

meanings.en: to fix something firmly in the mind
meanings.exampleEn: That terrible day is etched in my memory forever.
meanings.exampleTr: O korkunç gün sonsuza dek belleğime kazınmıştır.

meanings.en: life that continues forever, especially after death
meanings.exampleEn: Many religions promise their believers eternal life.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok din inananlarına sonsuz yaşam vaat eder.

meanings.en: the fact of belonging to a particular race or cultural group
meanings.exampleEn: The survey collected data on age, gender and ethnicity.
meanings.exampleTr: Anket yaş, cinsiyet ve etnik köken hakkında veri topladı.

meanings.en: a feeling of great happiness and excitement
meanings.exampleEn: The team was filled with euphoria after winning the championship.
meanings.exampleTr: Takım şampiyonluğu kazandıktan sonra coşkuyla doldu.

meanings.en: a person who judges the quality, value or importance of something
meanings.exampleEn: An independent evaluator assessed the success of the programme.
meanings.exampleTr: Bağımsız bir değerlendirici programın başarısını değerlendirdi.

meanings.en: the act of avoiding something you are supposed to do, especially in a dishonest way
meanings.exampleEn: He was charged with tax evasion.
meanings.exampleTr: Vergi kaçırmaktan suçlandı.

meanings.en: despite the fact that; used to introduce a surprising contrast
meanings.exampleEn: Even though it was raining, they went for a walk.
meanings.exampleTr: Yağmur yağmasına rağmen yürüyüşe çıktılar.

meanings.en: used to refer to all the members of a group individually
meanings.exampleEn: She checks her email every morning.
meanings.exampleTr: Her sabah e-postasını kontrol eder.

meanings.en: every person
meanings.exampleEn: Everybody was happy to hear the good news.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkes iyi haberi duyunca mutlu oldu.

meanings.en: every person
meanings.exampleEn: Everyone in the class passed the exam.
meanings.exampleTr: Sınıftaki herkes sınavı geçti.

meanings.en: all things; all that exists or is relevant
meanings.exampleEn: She told me everything about the trip.
meanings.exampleTr: Gezi hakkında bana her şeyi anlattı.

meanings.en: to force someone to leave a property using a legal process
meanings.exampleEn: The landlord threatened to evict them for not paying rent.
meanings.exampleTr: Ev sahibi kirayı ödemedikleri için onları tahliye etmekle tehdit etti.

meanings.en: to make a bad situation, problem or illness worse
meanings.exampleEn: The new tax will only exacerbate the country's economic problems.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni vergi ülkenin ekonomik sorunlarını yalnızca kötüleştirecek.

meanings.en: a precise number or amount, without rounding or approximation
meanings.exampleEn: I don't know the exact figure, but sales rose by about ten percent.
meanings.exampleTr: Kesin rakamı bilmiyorum ama satışlar yaklaşık yüzde on arttı.

meanings.en: to dig in the ground to find buried objects or remove earth
meanings.exampleEn: Archaeologists excavated the ancient city over several years.
meanings.exampleTr: Arkeologlar antik kenti birkaç yıl boyunca kazdılar.

meanings.en: to be extremely good at a particular activity or subject
meanings.exampleEn: She excels at mathematics and physics.
meanings.exampleTr: Matematik ve fizikte çok başarılıdır.
